purpose: Monte Carlo simulation of stablecoin reserve portfolios under MiCA Article 36 redemption stress and asset price shocks. 1,000 paths × 90-day horizon. Coverage ratio fan chart (P5–P95), breach probability curve, Article 36 liquid buffer analysis, fire-sale contagion estimate. Complements ART-06 (static attestation) with full stochastic dimension.
